name: Avalon USDa
oneLiner: USDa is Avalon's BTC-backed CDP stablecoin with 1:1 USDT convertibility, leveraging institutional credit lines and proprietary HFT liquidation logic.
collateral: FBTC (tokenized BTC, Cobo-custodied) deposited as overcollateralized CDP; USDT/USDC can be deposited 1:1 (exempt from liquidation); protocol assets held with Cobo, Fireblocks, and Coinbase Prime custody and backed by multi-billion-dollar institutional balance sheets
pegMechanism: 1:1 USDT convertibility (redemptions require loan repayment or conversion to USDT); overcollateralized against FBTC priced by Redstone oracle; HFT liquidation algorithm sells collateral on centralized exchanges to restore target LTV; cross-chain via LayerZero OFT

oracleRisk.summary: Avalon USDa uses RedStone BTC-USD pricing for its FBTC-backed CeDeFi CDP, with governed LTV thresholds and an operational liquidation algorithm that sells collateral on centralized exchanges.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: USDa supports collateralized borrowing against FBTC with published maximum, liquidation, and recovery LTV parameters. Its CeDeFi account model and centralized-exchange liquidation differ from permissionless onchain auctions, but they still form a distinct collateral-price and liquidation branch that must be reviewed; 1:1 USDT and USDC deposits are documented as non-liquidatable conversion collateral.

branches.label: Avalon CeDeFi FBTC collateral
branches.summary: FBTC-backed USDa borrowing uses RedStone BTC-USD pricing, published LTV thresholds, and Avalon-operated centralized-exchange liquidation.

feeds.path: RedStone BTC-USD feed -> Avalon CeDeFi risk monitor -> account LTV

branches.fallbackBehavior: Avalon identifies RedStone as the primary BTC-USD oracle and continuous centralized-exchange monitoring, but the reviewed documentation does not name a secondary contractual feed or automatic onchain fallback.

collateralParameters.note: Avalon publishes a 90% liquidation LTV and an 80% recovery LTV for FBTC-backed positions; USDT and USDC deposits are listed as 100% max LTV and not subject to liquidation.

branches.liquidationMechanism: When an FBTC account exceeds the 90% liquidation LTV, withdrawals are restricted and Avalon sells part of the collateral on centralized exchanges through its high-frequency execution system until the account reaches the 80% recovery LTV.
branches.backstop: The reviewed USDa documentation describes collateral sale and institutional custody providers but does not identify a contractual reserve fund, insurance module, or permissionless recapitalization backstop for residual bad debt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The reviewed USDa materials do not document a global shutdown settlement or a contractual process for allocating losses that remain after centralized-exchange collateral liquidation.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: On-chain re-verified 2026-07-20: USDa is a LayerZero OFT mesh. Ethereum is the native home deployment (immutable AccessControl OFT; endpoint() = EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c; owner() = the reviewed 5-of-6 Safe 0xdFB1b1c0E0f697829aF500D73364D863Cb3c6cE9; native minting via two reviewed MINT_ROLE proxies). Every satellite EVM deployment is a live OFT: endpoint() verified per chain (canonical 0x1a44... on ethereum/bsc/mantle/klaytn/taiko/sei/base/avalanche/bob; chain-specific LayerZero endpoints on berachain/sonic/bitlayer/morph-l2 (0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b), nibiru (0x2a5e79dee6e3544588bb3b675b1cc3354df2aefd), zksync (0xd07c30af3ff30d96bdc9c6044958230eb797ddbf), and corn (0xcb566e3b6934fa77258d68ea18e931fa75e1aaaa, from verified constructor args); eid() matches each chain). OFT owner()/delegate is the Avalon 5-of-6 Safe (same six signers) on bsc/mantle/klaytn/berachain/sei/sonic/nibiru/bitlayer/base/avalanche/morph-l2/bob/corn, and signer EOA 0xd955f0c167adbf7d553fc4d59a964a1b115cc093 on taiko/zksync/zircuit (eth_getCode = 0). peers() on the ethereum OFT returns these exact contracts for base/avalanche/zksync/bob/morph-l2/zircuit, and on-chain totalSupply matches DefiLlama's per-chain balances exactly on every new chain. Movement is a MoveVM LayerZero OFT (oft_fa) whose module account is owned by a 3-of-4 Move multisig. The Mode deployment tracked by DefiLlama (0x0000206329b97DB379d5E1Bf586BbDB969C63274) is NOT part of this mesh: no OFT peer on ethereum/bsc, a third-party 4-of-6 upgrade Safe with non-Avalon signers, and an unverified implementation, so that row stays unresolved. Burn-mint OFT routes ride the LayerZero DVN network; the per-application DVN set is not reviewed, so routes are external-validated-network.

review.evidence: Complete Ethereum role-event replay through block 25712112 identifies exactly two live MINT_ROLE holders and the sole current admin Safe. Direct storage and owner() reads establish both transparent-proxy minter implementations, their two ProxyAdmins, and common 5-of-6 Safe ownership. Both implementations remain unverified, so no call-level issuance cap can be established; the Safe can grant MINT_ROLE or upgrade either minter proxy, making aggregate economic cap semantics unbounded. The immutable USDa token also uses LayerZero OFT peer minting; deployment route semantics remain separately represented by bridgeRouteRisk rather than duplicated as an unidentified mint control.

reserveReview.rationale: R02 refresh 2026-08-08: Avalon documentation still describes two mint paths (FBTC-backed CeDeFi CDP loan; USDT/USDC deposited 1:1) and 1:1 USDT conversion via an Ethereum vault, with no published supply-weighted split between FBTC-collateralized debt and 1:1 fiat-token deposits. Risk-management still lists FBTC (60% max LTV / 90% liquidation / 80% recovery, liquidatable) plus USDC and USDT at 100% max LTV and not subject to liquidation, and names Cobo, Fireblocks, and Coinbase Prime for protocol-asset custody without publishing addresses, provider shares, or segregation terms. DefiLlama's avalon-usda CDP adapter methodology counts FBTC collateral plus optional USDT/USDe/sUSDe at documented pool and USDaMinter Safe owners; the live protocol endpoint reports ~$2 TVL (residual USDe only) versus ~$148M DefiLlama circulating USDa. The adapter source explicitly excludes Avalon-minted wrappers (lfbtc, WFBTC) and V3/Movement treasuries as team-only/dead-liquidity positions. On-chain adapter balances therefore do not reconcile circulating liability, and no dual-source percentage split is available, so the single reserve is dispositioned as an untracked exogenous asset rather than a splittable basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Officially documented issuance and collateral paths; constituent shares remain undisclosed; independent DefiLlama CDP TVL and circulating-supply read confirm non-reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The single disclosed reserve category is now classified as an untracked exogenous CeDeFi envelope. Avalon does not publish the current proportions of FBTC-backed debt, USDT deposits, and USDC deposits, and on-chain adapter balances do not measure full backing.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: FBTC-backed CDP positions and USDT/USDC 1:1 mint reserves
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The supported constituents are documented, but no current supply-weighted split supports individual stablecoin or cryptoasset dependency weights. DefiLlama's adapter does not capture the material FBTC collateral backing circulating USDa, and on-chain adapter owners do not hold material measured reserves, so the aggregate is treated as an exogenous CeDeFi envelope rather than a splittable stablecoin basket.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: risk-management still names Cobo, Fireblocks, and Coinbase Prime and asserts custody addresses are publicly available, but the reviewed pages do not list those addresses, provider share, legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms.
